name: Project X-Nexus Executor
changelog: V1.11.0: New Capture tab. Record Roblox video through Windows Game Bar and open the Windows Captures folder from X-Nexus. Capture up to five minutes of actual displayed-frame data with the verified Intel PresentMon 2.5.1 helper; see average FPS, sampled 1% low and peak FPS, while retaining the raw local CSV. The portable ZIP includes PresentMon, its MIT License, setup notes and SHA-256 checksums. Nothing is uploaded by X-Nexus.
